scope: identical complete production-scored candidates, offline reordering only
limitations: Same-project results are in-sample; test on independent repositories.
This is chunk-level reordering with file rank defined by first occurrence.
Symbol metrics require independently reviewed expected_symbol labels.
Offline sorting time excludes full production reranking and embedding.
Temporary Chroma may leave locked files on Windows until process exit.

results.query: Where is the sequence of research processing stages assembled into a workflow?
Which component decides whether a draft needs another revision?
Where does the application plan what information to investigate?
Which component gathers material for the research workflow?
Where are findings condensed before producing a report?
Which component writes an initial report from gathered evidence?
Where is a generated report reviewed for weaknesses?
Where are the data structures holding shared workflow context defined?
Which component prepares a new request for processing by the research workflow?
Where is progress streamed to clients during a research operation?
Which module handles retrying failed language model requests?
Where is external information gathered using a web search utility?
Which component sets up resources when the web application starts?
Where is the HTTP endpoint for checking service availability?
Which test checks whether the browser interface can be served?
